scope: Analyze completed original-source observations without new particle tracing.

c2_aperture.interpretation: Complete source rays remain well within the inserted 50 um-radius aperture at its exact observation; production finite-boundary interception reports no stopped source particles.

surface.d95_definition: Diameter containing 95% of actual specimen-plane current about its current-weighted centroid; not an angle or an emitted-current cutoff.
surface.rms_definition: Square root of the current-weighted mean squared centroid radius using all surviving positive-current particles.

descriptive_regression.scope: Read-only regression of existing observed complex transverse positions on mechanical angle; no ray removal, retuning, current renormalization or new transport.
descriptive_regression.inference: The strong cubic-angle association and additional energy dependence support a reproducible nonlinear/dispersion tail. This is not an isolated-lens aberration calibration or a causal perturbation experiment.

source_model_comparison.observed_difference: The historical profile explicitly uses driven_gaussian_schell with a 20 nm transverse coherence length; the current actual default is classical_particles without that Tip coherence boundary. Actual historical launch slopes are about 21 mrad per axis, versus about 0.971 mrad transverse direction per axis now. Gun voltages are identical.
source_model_comparison.interpretation: The old 6.939 um RMS gun-exit source and its predicted aperture filling are not the currently executed 0.379 um RMS source. Historical curvature was used only as a zero-current focusing proposal and must not qualify current source width, current or aberrations.

conclusions.original_source_integrity: All completed observations retain unique original IDs, positive equal weights, original emission IDs and full physical transmission. Same-count optical trials preserve exact emission and gun-exit arrays.
conclusions.current_transmission: 100% transmission is supported by actual original-current accounting and a C2 pupil maximum near 13.3 um inside the real 50 um-radius inserted aperture; it was not created by rejecting or renormalizing tails.
conclusions.tails: The focused 1024 population contains a consequential high-angle tail: its largest particle contributes about 10% of the radial second moment. At 2048 particles a second comparably large tail is resolved, arguing against a single corrupt or isolated packet.
conclusions.statistical_distinction: D95 can exclude an outer current tail that still strongly influences RMS radius and RMS-waist position. Both native waist diagnostics must remain separate.
conclusions.limits: These are classical geometrical particle statistics; no coherent diffraction-limited probe size or wave-resolution qualification is claimed.
